content.title: McDonald's new 'KPop Demon Hunters' adult Happy Meals starts today
content.text: March 31, 2026Updated April 1, 2026, 2:12 p.m. CTMcDonald's is launching two adult Happy Meals and a new sweet treat today. Fans of "KPop Demon Hunters" can back their favorite K-Pop group with the limited-time food deals. They'll also get access to exclusive online content.Ready to weigh in on the Battle for the Fans? Pick the Saja Boys breakfast or a Huntr/X nugget and fries combo. Or both.In the film, South Korean girl group Huntr/X fights evil and protects people with their music. The Saja Boys, a boy band of all demons, tries to knock Huntr/X from the charts. It was made for kids but has found fans of all ages."With McDonald's, we were able to turn the rivalry between The Saja Boys and Huntr/X into something fans can actually experience, drawing inspiration from Korean culture and food traditions that sit at the heart of the film," said Marian Lee, chief marketing officer for Netflix, in a news release.The Netflix movie just won two Oscars. One is for the song "Golden." The second was for best animated feature film. A sequel is being developed.Here's what to know about the new menu items, when you can get them in Mississippi and how it affectsWhen can I get an adult Happy Meal at McDonald's?The 'KPop Demon Hunters' meals are coming to participating stores on Tuesday, March 31.They'll be available for a limited time.What comes in the 'KPop Demon Hunters' meals"From Ramyeon McShaker Fries to Demon sauces paired with Soda Pop, every detail was designed to feel like it could have come straight out of a scene in the movie," said Netflix's Lee.Both options have an iconic Happy Meal box and a collectible card pack of the music groups. There's also a Derpy the Tiger card with a QR code.It lets you access exclusive content on the McDonald's app. It's a special reveal of the group that wins the Battle for the Fans, according to a McDonald's news release.Scan by April 26 for the first-access and exclusive content.Huntr/X Meal highlights the group's favorite noodlesThe 10-piece McNugget meal comes with Hunter Sauce, described as "a sweet chili sauce mixing notes of chili, garlic and pepper with just enough heat," and Demon Sauce, which is "a bold mustard sauce with heat and tang – made purple, just like demon patterns."It also features Ramyeon McShaker Fries. Ramyeon is a Korean instant noodle dish similar to ramen, which is Japanese and usually has fresh noodles. There's a seasoning packet with soy, garlic, sesame and spices that you shake into the fries. Toss the fries in the shaker bag to distribute the flavor.Saja Boys breakfast brings the heatThe Saja boys meal is a Sausage McMuffin with Egg, topped with a peppery Spicy Saja Sauce.You also get hash browns and a small soft drink.Derpy McFlurry pairs ice cream with bobaThe new frozen sweet is inspired by Derpy the Tiger, from the animated film.The Derpy McFlurry, blends creamy vanilla soft serve with berry popping pearls in a wild berry sauce.How many McDonald's locations are in Mississippi?According to ScrapeHero, there are 137 McDonald's restaurants in 90 cities.Out of Mississippi fast food, it ranks fourth for the number of locations in the state. Krispy Krunchy Chicken is No. 3 with 167 locations in 100 cities. Subway has 281 locations in 141 cities. And the No. 1 chain with the most locations near you is Hunt Brothers Pizza, with 655 locations in 271 cities.Mike Snider is a national trending news reporter for USA TODAY.
